title: Juicy Floral Dutch Vegetable Gratin
description: A rich and flavorful Dutch dish featuring a variety of vegetables in a floral and juicy sauce, perfect for a date night, made with melted butter and cooked to perfection using sous-vide. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced carrots, zucchini, bell peppers, and onion.
In a small bowl, mix together the melted butter, minced garlic, chopped thyme, and dried lavender.
Pour the butter mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Season the vegetables with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the vegetables in a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the vegetables in the sous-vide machine for 2 hours.
While the vegetables are cooking, prepare the cheese sauce by combining the shredded Gruyere cheese and whipped heavy cream in a bowl.
After the vegetables have cooked, remove them from the sous-vide bag and place them in a baking dish.
Pour the cheese sauce over the vegetables and top with additional shredded Gruyere cheese.
Place the baking dish under the broiler and cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
